title: Where Does the Escalator Handrail Go? #Shorts
description:
You grab it every trip and it never runs out. The handrail is one rubber loop: it rides the top, swings around rollers at the end, sneaks back underneath upside down, and a drive wheel chained to the step motor pushes it along. Plus why your hand sometimes drifts behind your feet.
